Based on an investigation of the three degraded services, it is highly probable that the incidents share a single root cause. 

Analysis of the dependencies for each service—checkout-service, search-service, and auth-service—reveals that PostgreSQL is the only common infrastructure component shared by all three. While each service exhibits different symptoms (503 errors, timeouts, and 500 errors), the unavailability or performance degradation of the PostgreSQL database is a candidate cause for all three services. 

Given that PostgreSQL is the only dependency shared across the entire set, you should prioritize investigating the health, connection pool status, and load metrics of your PostgreSQL instance as the likely single point of failure.
